claim: GIE's EPP defines OutputInjectionHeaders including the destination-endpoint key (x-gateway-destination-endpoint) as a system-owned header that is stripped from any client-supplied value before headers are forwarded to Envoy.
stance_target: a malicious/untrusted client can set x-gateway-destination-endpoint themselves to redirect Envoy's ORIGINAL_DST routing

claim: generateHeaders() (request path to backend/Envoy) and generateResponseHeaders() (response path) both skip any header key for which IsSystemOwnedHeader() returns true, so a client-injected destination-endpoint header is dropped from the passthrough loop and only EPP's explicitly-set real target endpoint header reaches Envoy.
stance_target: malicious clients can override EPP's routing decision via header injection

claim: A unit test added in PR #2025 directly demonstrates the fix defeats a spoofed destination-endpoint header: an inbound request map sets the destination-endpoint key to an attacker IP:port, but after generateHeaders() runs, the output header carries EPP's own computed TargetEndpoint value instead.
stance_target: clients can set x-gateway-destination-endpoint to redirect routing after the fix

claim: The same sanitization is mirrored on the response path: a corresponding test proves a client/backend-supplied destination-endpoint or content-length value in response headers is also stripped before being surfaced.
stance_target: response-path header spoofing of routing metadata is possible after the fix

claim: Prior to the fix, EPP also failed to strip client-set flow-control headers like the fairness-ID and objective headers before forwarding, requiring a broader InputControlHeaders blocklist beyond just destination-endpoint.
stance_target: the header-trust problem in EPP was systemic across multiple header categories, not limited to destination-endpoint
quoted_support: InputControlHeaders = map[string]bool{ strings.ToLower(metadata.FlowFairnessIDKey): true, strings.ToLower(metadata.ObjectiveKey): true, strings.ToLower(metadata.ModelNameRewriteKey): true, strings.ToLower(metadata.SubsetFilterKey): true, }
